ground_truth.notes: Police released a list of six charged scenes: ram-01, ram-02, ram-03, ram-04, ram-07 and ram-09. Police called the man a person of interest in ram-06. The criminal complaint also describes ram-05, ram-08, ram-10 and ram-11, so all eleven are listed as linked, but only six are on the police arrest list and sources disagree on how many incidents are charged. Court documents do not show police acting on the public tip about the pickup between March and the arrest. A bar burglary in Oronoco on 2025-03-06 was reported as under county sheriff investigation and is not in the series sources, so it is not recorded. Nearly $8,000 in cash was reportedly taken in total.

outcome.summary: Arrest 2025-06-10 and charges 2025-06-12; guilty plea reported 2026-06-26 to one second-degree burglary and one first-degree property damage count; sentencing set for October 2026
